name: com.eliranshaya.devkit
description: Zero-setup, runtime-generated developer and cheat panel for Unity. Drop one empty GameObject into a scene, call Open(), and a full debug panel builds itself at runtime - actions, live watches and editable tables, with no prefabs, no sprites and no scene wiring. Stripped entirely from release builds through the DEVKIT_ENABLED define symbol.

samples.description: A wallet and a set of cheats, showing both registration styles.
